k:少.mnemonic: Small (小) with an extra slide (ノ): even a bit of the small has slid away. Few (little).
k:少.hint: Small with a piece sliding off.

k:天.mnemonic: One (一) line above big (大): the thing above a person with arms spread is the sky, heaven. Heaven.
k:天.hint: The line above the big person.

k:実.mnemonic: A roof (宀), then three lines and a big (大) figure: the harvest stacked under the roof, real and solid. Truth (reality, fruit).

k:送.mnemonic: Heaven (天) with horns, sent down the path (辶). Send.

k:化.mnemonic: A leader (亻) and a spoon (匕): a person turned upside down, transformed. Transform (change).

k:句.mnemonic: A mouth (口) held in a cradle (勹): a single unit of speech. Phrase.

k:号.mnemonic: A mouth (口) over a hooked line: someone shouting out a number. Issue (number).

k:鳥.mnemonic: A bird with its crest, eye, wing and tail feathers. Bird.

k:島.mnemonic: A bird (鳥) sitting on a mountain (山) in the sea. Island.
k:島.hint: Bird on a mountain in the sea.

k:決.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵), a handle (ユ) and a person (人): the person grabs the handle and opens the floodgate. Decide.

k:区.mnemonic: A crate (匚) with a cross inside: a box divided into districts. Ward (district).

k:舌.mnemonic: A mouth (口) with a tongue sticking up and out of it. Tongue.

k:画.mnemonic: A rice field (田) in a pit (凵) with a line on top: a picture in a frame. Drawing (picture, stroke).

k:話.mnemonic: Say (言) with the tongue (舌). Talk.

k:近.mnemonic: An axe (斤) on the path (辶). Never walk near a person carrying an axe. Near.

k:取.mnemonic: An ear (耳) and a hand (又): a hand taking an ear, as warriors did after battle. Take.

k:孝.mnemonic: A child (子) carrying an elder (耂) on their back. Filial piety.

k:教.mnemonic: Filial piety (孝) with a strike (攵): a stick to encourage the lesson. Teach.

k:先.mnemonic: Soil (土) on legs (儿), with a hairpin on top: someone walking ahead of you across the ground. Ahead (previous).

k:辛.mnemonic: Stand (立) over a ten (十): a tattooing needle used for punishment. Spicy (bitter, hard).

k:幸.mnemonic: A lid (亠) on the spicy (辛) needle: the punishment is covered up. What luck: happiness.

k:報.mnemonic: Soil (土), happiness (幸), a stamp (卩) and a hand (又). You stamp the news into the soil by hand: a report. Report.

k:選.mnemonic: Two cobras (已) on the path (辶) with a base under them. You must choose which one to step over. Choose (elect).

k:関.mnemonic: A gate (門) with horns (丷) and heaven (天) inside: the barrier gate. Whoever passes it has a connection. Connection (barrier).

k:単.mnemonic: Sparkles (⺌) over a rice field (田) with a ten (十): a single simple field. Simple (single).

k:戦.mnemonic: Simple (単) and a halberd (戈): war is simple with a halberd. War (battle).
